title: Xtraq tracked configuration
description: JSON schema for .xtraqconfig and .xtraqconfig.local files. Root-level files always include the resolved Namespace; other properties remain optional so the file stays minimal.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference injected by the CLI for IntelliSense.

ProjectPath.description: Optional redirect to the project root that owns .xtraqconfig/.env. Use "." for the current directory or relative/absolute paths.

Namespace.description: Root namespace for generated artifacts. xtraq init resolves and persists this automatically for the root configuration.

OutputDir.description: Relative output directory for generated artifacts.

TargetFramework.description: Template hint for generated projects (for example net8.0 or net10.0).

BuildSchemas.description: Allow-list of schemas to include during generation. Empty list means include all.

AutoBind.description: Global parameter auto-bind allow-list for API endpoints.

AutoBindProcedures.description: Schema-qualified procedures that should participate in automatic parameter auto-binding.
